results.content: As part of the prestigious L'Oreal-UNESCO Women in Science Awards, global rising stars are selected from the 275 female scientists awarded fellowships in 117 countries. Only 15 women become part of the International Rising Talents program. For her work on next-generation structural materials, Ogawa became one of them.
